atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind 4 — defines design tokens as CSS variables that become utility classes. `@theme inline` emits utilities that reference the variable at runtime instead of baking in the value resolved at build time, which is what lets the palette follow light/dark.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind 4 — registers a custom utility class that works with variants like `hover:` and `md:`.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind 4 — applies a Tailwind variant (such as `dark` or `hover`) to the styles in the block.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind 4 — defines a new variant that can then be used as a prefix on utilities.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines existing utility classes into custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind 4 — explicitly registers a path for class detection, for files the automatic scan misses.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind 4 — imports a stylesheet for `@apply`/`@variant` resolution without emitting its CSS. Used in scoped styles.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind 4 — loads a legacy `tailwind.config.js` for compatibility.

atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Tailwind 3 directive that injected a layer. Superseded in v4 by `@import "tailwindcss"` — listed here only so older snippets don't warn.
